strongs_1890.strongs_def: a tower (from its size or height); by analogy, a rostrum; figuratively, a (pyramidal) bed of flowers
strongs_1890.derivation: also (in plural) feminine מִגְדָּלָה; from H1431 (גָּדַל);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: castle, flower, tower. Compare the names following.
